primary_task: Write an application that uses the GitHub Copilot SDK (create client, session, send messages, tools, hooks, MCP) in Node.js, Python, Go or .NET.

requirements.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
requirements.evidence: 'Requires GitHub Copilot CLI installed and a GitHub Copilot subscription (unless using BYOK).'; Prerequisites: '**GitHub Copilot CLI** installed and authenticated (`copilot --version`)'
requirements.basis: bash: 'install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt ...)', but the document only links installation docs and names no package; check whether the CLI is on npm.

requirements.name: GitHub Copilot subscription / Copilot auth, or a BYOK key (alternatives, any one suffices)
requirements.evidence: '**GitHub Copilot subscription** (Individual, Business, or Enterprise) - not required for BYOK'; auth methods include 'GitHub CLI - `gh auth` credentials'
requirements.basis: 'The user's GitHub account is usable through the github connector and through the gh CLI via the proxy.' but lacks: 'accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub'; whether the GitHub account has Copilot is not stated. BYOK keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure) are unavailable.

requirements.name: Copilot model-provider endpoint (host not named for default mode)
requirements.evidence: 'Your App -> SDK Client -> [stdio/TCP] -> Copilot CLI -> Model Provider'
requirements.basis: Allow-list names github.com, api.github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com; 'other hosts are refused'. The document does not name the Copilot inference host, so it cannot be decided.

requirements.name: Node.js 18+ / Python 3.8+ / Go 1.21+ / .NET 8 (one of)
requirements.evidence: '**Runtime:** Node.js 18+ / Python 3.8+ / Go 1.21+ / .NET 8.0+'; install via npm, pip, go get, dotnet add package
requirements.basis: bash: 'install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, go modules, nuget, GitHub release downloads)'.

requirements.name: Docker Compose (deployment pattern)
requirements.basis: lacks: 'a Docker daemon (docker, docker compose and container builds cannot run)'. One of several deployment patterns.

requirements.name: api.openai.com / Azure / api.anthropic.com (BYOK providers)
requirements.basis: lacks: 'network access to hosts outside the egress allow-list' and 'API keys or credentials for external services'; optional alternative.

notes: Reading taken: the deliverable is writing SDK code; authentication and the model endpoint are unknown rather than refused. If the Copilot inference host is treated as outside the allow-list (only github.com hosts are open) and the code must run end to end, the verdict would be BLOCKED. Writing and compiling the code is possible; a live run is the uncertain part.
